description: T23S remaining-native-specials manifest (issue #102): real TiKV-backed TiFlash replica lifecycle plus the alter-primary-key=true startup-config matrix. Baseline anchors and their db/CLI coverage are preserved verbatim; the increment adds three infra_only anchors (PD/TiKV/TiFlash), one TiKV-backed TiDB server, and one unistore alter-primary-key=true aux TiDB. Authorization-gated — not runnable until the resource increment is approved.

metadata_cases.sql: ALTER TABLE t23fx.t23fx_tf SET TIFLASH REPLICA 1;
metadata_cases.note: Real TiFlash arm on the TiKV-backed stack (1 PD + 1 TiKV + 1 TiFlash). Product side keeps the loader-gap verdict: tiflash_replica is never queried, so AVAILABLE stays a native fact, not a product claim. Native arms prove, in order: over-count refusal (2 > 1 store, refused at DDL time), declaration, bounded poll until AVAILABLE=1, a forced tidb_isolation_read_engines='tiflash' read plus EXPLAIN task evidence, REPLICA 0 clear, and one rebuild+re-read. No compaction benefit, space recovery, or HA claim.

metadata_cases.oracle_basis: product: probe-derived — same unverified review as the frozen unistore arm; the loader gap (tiflash_replica never queried, plus the columns-charset fact gap) is unchanged by topology. native: replica_count>stores refuses at DDL time (upstream checkTiFlashReplicaCount); AVAILABLE is the persisted DDL-owner flag, polled with a bounded cap — an exhausted poll is recorded timeout_undetermined, never a success; the forced-engine read and the EXPLAIN task marker are the actual-serve proof. COMPACT arm asserts request acceptance only (serial CmdCompact RPCs exist upstream; no compaction benefit measured).

metadata_cases.oracle_basis: product: probe-derived — pass/complete; no rule adjudicates handle type for a legal auto_increment PK. native: int_only+apk=false -> clustered, verified by the /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */ SHOW CREATE marker (distinct from NONCLUSTERED because the full marker text cannot collide as a substring).

metadata_cases.sql: CREATE TABLE t23fx.t23apk_p (id BIGINT UNSIGNED PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, v INT);
metadata_cases.note: apk=true DIFFERENTIATOR: under INT_ONLY the deprecated alter-primary-key knob flips the bare single-int PK to NONCLUSTERED (upstream ShouldBuildClusteredIndex requires !AlterPrimaryKey). Product passes the legal statement either way; the clustered-vs-not distinction is native-only evidence.
